scope: Recovery of the pre-existing private W1 generation-2 terminal after participant service manifest reconvergence
cause: The Ansible services role restarted feam-service-runtime.service when the runtime manifest or helper changed. That required oneshot pulled down user@2101.service and rootless Docker, cleanly stopping the unrelated running W1 container before the fake site stop.
repair: The six explicit service layout calls remain before the runtime oneshot task; the task now ensures that the oneshot is started without restarting it on manifest changes. One fixed W1 start operation restored the existing generation-2 container. No container recreation, reset, deletion, or dataset mutation was used.
limitation: The earlier W1 running-state interruption remains a recorded regression. This addendum verifies recovery of the same container and terminal socket; it does not erase the interruption or claim a fresh W1 browser walkthrough.
